$comment: CODM detector pack. All ROIs, texts and colours are UNVERIFIED until G1/G2 check them on corpus footage (source: docs/evidence/2026-10-27-g1-live-reference.md). Weights, windows and cooldowns are null: G3 proposes them from labelled data. No private names here; names come from data/profile.local.json at runtime. `version` is the pack version for every file in this folder; version history: CHANGELOG.md.

rois.label: Post-match MVP screen: MVP text and the name to its right
rois.note: Live capture 2: MVP at x 0.02-0.11, y 0.41-0.47; the name sits right of and below it (x 0.11-0.33, y 0.47-0.55) and slides in from the left.

rois.label: End screen (MP scoreboard or top 3, BR squad cards): MVP badge on a player card, the name beside it
rois.note: Pair MVP with the name box on the same card (right of or below the badge). MP top-3 cards: badge at y 0.84-0.87 under the card. MP full scoreboard: one MVP badge per team (own team y 0.65, enemy y 0.84), so the badge must pair with the name on its own row. BR squad cards: badge at y 0.78-0.80 under the MVP's avatar, name at y 0.81-0.82. Lobby Like toasts also carry an MVP tag (y 0.28-0.38) and profile/history pages show MVP-like text; exclude lobby and profile frames.

detectors.note: Match-level boost. Post-match MVP screen (postmatch_left) verified on live capture 2. End screens carry MVP badges for every MVP (both teams, teammates), so the badge counts only when paired with the profile name on the same card. Lobby Like toasts and profile pages are excluded.

detectors.name: Medals

Medal text stack with +N, right of centre

referenceDataset.layout: one subfolder per medal (slug of the medal text), crops inside, index.jsonl with one record per crop

detectors.note: Own HUD, no name match. Medals have a class: positive (clip signal, weight set by G3) or reference (weight 0, never a clip reason; detected and logged with crops into referenceDataset). Class and weight are data: promote a reference medal by changing its class to positive, clipReason to true and weight to a number. Relentless and Brutal are UNVERIFIED (not seen on footage). Bloodthirsty spelling seen on full-screen live capture 2. Normal Kill and First Blood are deliberately not medals. Suppressed while M2 is shown. User decisions 2026-10-27; the move of Revenge, Bloodthirsty, Saboteur, Berserker and Keep it Fresh to reference is an interpretation of the user's positive list (to confirm).

detectors.note: Action-density signal: a burst of popups in a short window. Seen: +125, +127, +252, +254, +256, small +2/+4. Suppressed while M2 is shown. G1: post-match XP screens show +NNNN outside the stack; count +N only with a medal or kill text in the same stack.

detectors.name: BR kill feed

detectors.note: Line: killer, weapon icon, knock-or-kill icon (falling figure = knock, skull = elimination), victim, count. Icon detection not specified yet. Own lines have an orange background on the corpus; on live capture 2 the lines of the user and squad mates have a purple bar (colour not measured, UNVERIFIED). G1: in the vertical cutout the killer side is cut off; own kills show only as an orange line with the victim name. Live capture 2: an own-event notification at top centre (x 0.28-0.46, y 0.17-0.21) shows 'attacker [knock|skull] You' when the user is downed or killed and '[knock] victim' when the user knocks someone.

detectors.note: Shows for other players too, so the name match is required. Text forms seen: nX MULTI-KILL, 5+ MULTI-KILL (BR), On a N killstreak! with N 5, 10, 20, 25 (other N values UNVERIFIED). In BR the squad list always shows the user's name, so the name must be inside the banner ROI, not anywhere on the frame. Correction 2026-10-28: X1 appears in BR as well as MP. A5b BR has 32 X1 banner_br hits, 5 with the profile name in the banner (docs/evidence/2026-10-27-p2b-w1-coverage-capture.md); the P2a gate note "seen in MP only" was wrong.

KNOCKED DOWN sits at y 0.39-0.44, ELIMINATED at y 0.43-0.47 with N DAMAGE DEALT or N KILL(S) beneath (to y 0.50). Live capture 2: that N KILL(S) is the user's own count (the corpus case near the top was a player banner). OCR often garbles DOWN (DOON, DORN).

stats.note: scoreRegex runs on the normalised text (no spaces); SCORE read 9/9 on the 2026-11-08 frames. killsHeaders are an assumption (no scoreboard frame). modeNames: the MP mode cues of g1_scan; only HARDPOINT is seen on a top-3 screen. endGapSec: end-screen hits closer than this are one match end (2026-11-08: VICTORY at 437 s, top 3 until 475 s). killLineHoldSec: an own kill-feed line seen again within this time with a similar victim text (victimMatchMin) is the same kill; the on-screen time of a line is not measured. 0.6.0: ranked Team Deathmatch top-3 cards read RATING n, not SCORE n (2026-11-09 2795-2810 s), so scoreRegex also takes RATING; ownScore then holds the rating. modeNames: objects {text, mode} read an on-screen spelling as a mode. 0.8.0: spectateDetectors are the detectors whose hits mark the streamer as dead and spectating; own kill-feed lines read inside such a hit (t to tEnd) never count (2026-11-09 practice). No own line was read there on that recording; the rule is a guard.

A mode name read in the header is evidence for the match whose end screens ended at most afterEndSec before it (match_gate.game_mode, source 'summary header'); it never counts for the next match. afterEndSec: the 9 header frames fell inside the end-screen span of their match (0 s after its last end-screen hit); 30 s is a margin, not measured. 2026-11-09 practice recording (H canvas, game area of the alpha project layout), full-frame OCR every 5 s, checked 2026-11-10 (docs/evidence/2026-11-10-lobby-mode-and-kill-dedup.md).

rois.note: 2026-11-09 practice recording (H canvas, game area of the alpha project layout), checked by eye 2026-11-10 (docs/evidence/2026-11-10-reel-own-kills-impact-play.md): banner box x 0.352-0.647, y 0.657-0.700, text x 0.39-0.61, y 0.67-0.69 on 4 frames of the third Search and Destroy match (1442, 1450, 1540, 1590 s). The spectated teammate's name bar sits above the HP bar at the bottom; the kill feed still runs.

detectors.note: The streamer is dead and spectates a teammate until the round ends (Search and Destroy). Negative signal like N1: data/clip/ranking.json death.detectors lists it, so no clip, montage or reel piece contains spectated play, and the match gate drops own-kill lines read inside it (S1 stats spectateDetectors). The kill feed keeps running while spectating; a teammate's kill is never an own kill (killer-side name rule), but a wrong read would otherwise show another player's play. The text is matched whole (partial ratio 0.85, box no more than twice its length); g1_scan.find_events.

suppressionRules.reason: The Impact Play replay (REC overlay) repeats the match medals; counting them again would double count.

endScreenRule.note: User decision 2026-10-27. Detect every end screen that appears (MVP, Impact Play, FINAL KILLCAM); a match may show more than one. Check the profile name on each screen separately. Each screen with the name is positive, but it counts once per match for scoring, and every named screen is listed as a reason. No screen with the name means no signal. No end screen has to appear.
